title: How this trader exploited a New Year glitch on Binance to make $1.5 million in a day
summary: A crypto trader, Vida, realized more than $1.5 million in gains after spotting an anomalous wall of buy orders on Binance for the little-known token BROCCOLI714 on New Year's Day.
